text: Assumption: After the call, scheduled or active callback instances are completed according to the serialization specification of the Communication Management before no further notifications occur — is this correct?

assumption: After the call, scheduled or active callback instances are completed according to the serialization specification of the Communication Management before no further notifications occur.
rationale: The payload describes the serialization requirement for callbacks in AUTOSAR_AP_EXP_ARAComAPI p. 46, but is silent on the exact timing of callbacks that are already signaled during deregistration.

original.text: Annahme: Nach dem Aufruf eingeplante oder aktive Callback-Instanzen dürften gemäß der Serialisierungsvorgabe des Communication Managements abgeschlossen werden, bevor keine weiteren Benachrichtigungen mehr erfolgen — trifft das zu?
